scope: Optional prepared signed per-axis coordinate policy and ordered sampler fault transport; legacy hardware preserved

baseline_emission.scope: Independent legacy coordinate emission from unchanged qualified pre-extension main-context source. Legacy sampler baseline is the prior main-context qualified emission.

development_oracle.explanation: The first allocation oracle incorrectly rejected valid zero-weight taps. Value correctness uses unfurled nonzero index-wrap coefficients; physical reads are separately checked against captured nonfault allocation bounds. No production arithmetic change was needed for that failure.

contract.policy: Independent repeat/clamp/mirrored-repeat, unsigned Q16.16 or signed S16.16
contract.prepared_metadata: Original addresses/weights shape retained; optional separate fault. Pipeline captures axis policy and binding. Prepared metadata overrides live sampler policy/base/dimensions.
contract.faults: Reserved modes and zero dimensions produce empty fault metadata; unsupported prepared mip/LOD/max-level inputs fault without reads. Faults retire in order; younger admissions cannot alter older held output/fault.
contract.ownership: Two prepared contexts share four physical read credits and ordered results. A one-cycle invalidation pulse is retained until old tap reads finish. Direct requests retain captured trilinear bindings in the prepared-capable sampler.

limits: No TexSampleUnit, shader ISA, native descriptor or general image/sampler resource exposure yet. Floating coordinate conversion and complete dimensional/format/filter semantics remain open.
